name: agentic-engineering
description: Claude Code plugins from Agentic Engineering, each with an eval suite that CI runs

plugins.name: permission-rules
plugins.description: Explains Claude Code permission rules: why a Bash command prompted, how allow and deny patterns match, and which commands prompt regardless of rules.

plugins.name: guard-hooks
plugins.description: A PreToolUse hook for rules that deny globs can't express: gh api writes, git reset --hard, a commit when origin is ahead, and printing secrets.

plugins.name: macuitest
plugins.description: Operate and test macOS apps through the accessibility tree with macuitest: reading the tree, press versus click, approval rules, and writing a UI test suite.
